## 2. Test Execution Commands

The test runner is a zero-dependency, self-contained Node.js ESM script (`scripts/verify-scrollytelling.mjs`) runnable across all platforms.

### Run Full Test Suite (Default)
Executes all 101 test assertions across Tiers 1–4, including ESLint check and static build validation:
```bash

```
*Expected exit code: `0`.*
